name: Gurigura
source:
A girl trained as a Ranger, the most agile of all classes of Knight. She lives in constant starvation in the Republic of Lancelot, and is something like a stray kitten.

[spoiler]She was [url=https://vndb.org/c72226]Bolonious[/url]'s favorite student. She was an orphan trained at Ranger Academy and sold off by the Academy to [url=https://vndb.org/c72140]Rochefort [/url] as her new master.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1061]Mangagamer[/url]]
